versions.changelog:
- Improved and clarified SKILL description for readability.
- Emphasized that free media utilities (like transcribe, convert, edit, thumbnail, remove background) require only a free account—no subscription.
- Updated trigger phrases in the description for broader and clearer coverage.
- No changes to functionality or interface; documentation and user guidance improvements only.

- Added detailed instructions for setting up and using the OpenClip MCP server with OAuth and manual token authentication.
- Clarified the five tool groups: clipping pipeline, uploads, free media utilities, UGC generation, and account/presets.
- Expanded documentation on asynchronous processing and status polling for all operations.
- Explained free media utility tools that require only an account (no subscription/credits).
- Included error handling best practices and limits on project/folder support.
- Provided operation cheat sheets and sample setup for popular clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor).
